recentItems.title: NBA 2K27 Gameplay With DLSS 5 On and Off: Is It Really AI Slop?
recentItems.description:
NBA 2K27 is here and it has full support of all DLSS 5 features, including making the faces of players look more realistic, maybe. In this video, we play a couple games with DLSS 5 on and DLSS 5 off, then show them back-to-back in order for you to decided if the framerate differences are worth the AI "enhancement" of character models in the game. AI Slop or not? Let us know in the comments! Gameplay was recorded at 4K resolution on an RTX 5090 GPU.

#IGN #DLSS5 #NBA2K27

recentItems.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game - Official Xbox Launch Trailer
recentItems.description: Don't miss the Xbox Launch Trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, the hit action fighting game developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. Players can fight as and against some of the biggest names in Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra with unique bending styles, abilities, and more. Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is available now on Xbox Series X|S alongside PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Fragmentary Order - Official Story Trailer
recentItems.description: Take a look at the Story Trailer for Fragmentary Order, an upcoming first-person tactical sci-fi shooter developed by Rant Gaming. Players can get a glimpse of the world of Fragmentary Order, where technological advances bring about a new age of society with devastating consequences. Fragmentary Order is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: Echoes of Silenced Bells Quest Guide | St. Tyna's Necklace Location
recentItems.description:
Navigating the "Echoes of Silenced Bells" quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker can easily leave you confused and running in circles. If you're trying to figure out how to sneak past St. Tyna's zombified nuns and secure a safe path to the library for Anca, this step-by-step walkthrough will show you exactly what you need to do to retrieve the elusive necklace, whether you prefer sneaking through the shadows at night or braving the daytime dangers!
 
In this Blood of Dawnwalker guide, we cover the seventh main story quest so you can help Coen gather the knowledge needed to outsmart the Vrakhiri. We'll show you how to navigate the refectory building, grab the crucial key from the caretaker's shed, and track down St. Tyna's necklace (also known as the Crimson Amber Medallion) in the sacristy. Whether you choose to use your vampire powers like shadow step and Compel Soul at night, or carefully parkour past the sleeping sisters during the day, this video has all the tips you need to deal with the guards and complete the mission.

recentItems.title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Revealed - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar Games and Sony have revealed a pair of limited edition PS5 DualSense controllers with a GTA 6 theme. One is black, the other white, and have the GTA 6 logo and other designs etched into the controllers. Both will be sold separately for about $85. Pre-orders will open via PlayStation Direct on September 10th. In other news, the final Final Fantasy 7 remake game now has a release date. Final Fantasy 7 Revelations will drop on April 8, 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and Nintendo Switch 2. And finally, Crimson Desert's first major story expansion will be available next month. It takes place after the main game has concluded, so you might want to wrap that up before diving into the new content.

recentItems.title: Borderlands 4 - Official Loveless Gameplay Overview Trailer
recentItems.description: Get a closer look at Loveless the Hacker in this latest Borderlands 4 gameplay trailer and see this new Vault Hunter's abilities and more. Ruthlessly exploit and attack the vulnerabilities in your enemies' defenses when Loveless the Hacker arrives in Borderlands 4 as paid DLC on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 10, 2026. Version 1.10 of Borderlands 4 also introduces the paid DLC of Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort and Bounty Pack 5: Amara and the Vile Shadows, all of which will be available for individual purchase.

Star Wars Zero Company - 7 Important Things You're Overlooking
recentItems.description:
​Think you know everything about Star Wars: Zero Company? Think again. Even the most seasoned fans can miss some of the galaxy’s best-kept secrets. There’s some heavy tutorialization in the opening few missions, so it can feel like the game has covered everything you need to know. But I’m 50 hours in, and still finding new things, including details about the Den's Lounge, how to use backup, the best way to complete operations, and more! So here are 7 things you’re overlooking in Star Wars: Zero Company.​

recentItems.title: Enshrouded - Official 1.0 Fixes Overview
recentItems.description:
Join the development team at Keen Games for a breakdown of what's coming to Enshrouded in the 1.0 update, including changes to the Fell Dragon Youngling, updraft changes, new player proportions, NPCs getting stuck, fishing improvements, and more. Enshrouded will leave early access, and version 1.0 will be available on Steam and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on October 15, 2026.

In Enshrouded, you are Flameborn, the last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG for up to 16 players.
